current.text: He is a rookie. The Rockets took him in the second round after four years of college.
In Summer League he averaged 16 points, 4 assists and over 2.5 steals, and shot 41% from three.
The Houston guard rotation is crowded. Fred VanVleet is back, and Marcus Smart and Bogdan Bogdanovic joined Amen Thompson and Reed Sheppard.
Coach Ime Udoka is defense-first, gives little room for error to weak defenders and plays his starters heavy minutes.
Lloyd thinks he might become a player. Another expert says he could make some impact from opening night as guard depth, and Summer League made Josh more confident he will find a rotation role.
With a March 28 end, the Rockets have a weak 3-3-4 fantasy playoff schedule, 10 games over the three weeks.

durable.text: He came into the NBA with elite shooting numbers across the board.
